description: An append-only B-tree running on a Hypercore.

sections.title: Usage

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Make a new Hyperbee instance. `core` should be a [Hypercore](https://github.com/holepunchto/hypercore).

options.name: valueEncoding
options.description: Same options as keyEncoding like "json", etc

methods.name: version
methods.description: Number that indicates how many modifications were made, useful as a version identifier.

methods.name: id
methods.description: String containing the id (z-base-32 of the public key) identifying this bee.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Buffer containing the public key identifying this bee.

methods.name: discoveryKey
methods.description: Buffer containing a key derived from `db.key`.

methods.name: writable
methods.description: Boolean indicating if we can put or delete data in this bee.

methods.name: readable
methods.description: Boolean indicating if we can read from this bee. After closing the bee this will be `false`.

methods.name: replicate

params.name: isInitiator
params.description: `true`/`false` to open a fresh replication stream, or an existing stream to replicate over.

methods.returns: The replication stream.
methods.description: See more about how replicate works at core.replicate.
examples:
const stream = db.replicate(true)
stream.pipe(remoteStream).pipe(stream)

methods.name: peek
methods.signature: const { seq, key, value } = await db.peek([range], [options])

params.name: opts
params.description: Read options (`reverse` selects the last entry instead of the first).

methods.returns: The first matching entry, or `null` if the range is empty.
methods.description: Similar to doing a read stream and returning the first value, but a bit faster than that.
examples: const first = await db.peek({ gte: 'a', lt: 'd' })

methods.name: createReadStream

params.name: range
params.description: `range` should specify the range you want to read and looks like this:

methods.returns: A stream of `Entry` objects.
methods.description: Make a read stream. Sort order is based on the binary value of the keys.

methods.name: createHistoryStream
methods.returns: A stream of `Entry` objects, each with an added `type` (`'put'` or `'del'`).
methods.description: Create a stream of all entries ever inserted or deleted from the db.

options.name: live
options.description: If true the stream will wait for new data and never end

options.name: reverse
options.description: If true get from the newest to the oldest

options.name: limit
options.description: Set to the max number of entries you want

examples:
{
  live: false, // If true the stream will wait for new data and never end
  reverse: false, // If true get from the newest to the oldest
  gte: seq, // Start with this seq (inclusive)
  gt: seq, // Start after this index
  lte: seq, // Stop after this index
  lt: seq, // Stop before this index
  limit: -1 // Set to the max number of entries you want
}

methods.name: createDiffStream

params.name: right
params.description: The other version to diff against: a version number, or another bee/snapshot.

params.name: range
params.description: `options` are the same as `db.createReadStream`, except for `reverse`.

methods.returns: A stream of `{ left, right }` pairs, where each side is an `Entry` or `null`.
methods.description: Efficiently create a stream of the shallow changes between two versions of the db.

methods.name: get
methods.signature: const { seq, key, value } = await db.get(key)

params.name: key
params.description: The key to look up (encoded per `keyEncoding`).

methods.returns: The entry, or `null` if the key is not present.
methods.description: Get a key's value. Returns `null` if key doesn't exists.
examples: const entry = await db.get('key') // => { seq, key, value } or null

methods.name: getBySeq
methods.returns: The block's key and value.
methods.description: Get the key and value from a block number.
examples: const { key, value } = await db.getBySeq(1)

methods.name: put

params.name: value
params.description: The value to store; optional for key-only entries.

methods.returns: Resolves once the write is committed to the core.
methods.description: Insert a new key. Value can be optional.

methods.name: batch
methods.returns: A new batch; queue writes on it and call `flush()` to commit.
methods.description: Make a new atomic batch that is either fully processed or not processed at all.

methods.name: del
methods.returns: Resolves once the deletion is committed to the core.
methods.description: Delete a key.

methods.name: watch

params.name: range
params.description: Range bounds to narrow what changes are watched; same as `db.createReadStream` except `reverse`.

methods.returns: Returns a new value after a change, `current` and `previous` are snapshots that are auto-closed before next value.
methods.description: Listens to changes that are on the optional `range`.

methods.name: getAndWatch
methods.returns: Returns a watcher which listens to changes on the given key.
methods.description: `entryWatcher.node` contains the current entry in the same format as the result of `bee.get(key)`, and will be updated as it changes.
examples:
const w = await db.getAndWatch('config')
w.on('update', () => console.log(w.node.value))

methods.name: checkout
methods.returns: A read-only bee pinned to that version.
methods.description: Get a read-only snapshot of a previous version.
examples:
const old = db.checkout(5)
const entry = await old.get('key')

methods.name: snapshot
methods.returns: A read-only bee pinned to the current version.
methods.description: Shorthand for getting a checkout for the current version.
examples: const snap = db.snapshot()

methods.name: sub

params.name: prefix
params.description: The namespace prefix applied to every key.

methods.returns: A bee scoped to the prefixed keyspace.
methods.description: Create a sub-database where all entries will be prefixed by a given value.

options.name: valueEncoding
options.description: Optional sub valueEncoding (defaults to the parents)

options.name: keyEncoding
options.description: Optional sub keyEncoding (defaults to the parents)

methods.name: getHeader

params.name: opts
params.description: `options` are the same as the `core.get` method.

methods.returns: Returns the header contained in the first block.
methods.description: `options` are the same as the `core.get` method.
examples: const header = await db.getHeader()

methods.name: isHyperbee

params.name: opts
params.description: `options` are the same as the `core.get` method.

methods.returns: Returns `true` if the core contains a Hyperbee, `false` otherwise.
methods.description: This requests the first block on the core, so it can throw depending on the options.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: Waits until internal state is loaded.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Fully close this bee, including its core.

methods.name: core
methods.description: The underlying Hypercore backing this bee.

methods.name: constructor
methods.signature: new Batch(tree, core, batchLock, cache, options = {})

methods.name: get
methods.signature: const { seq, key, value } = await batch.get(key)

params.name: key
params.description: The key to look up (encoded per the batch's `keyEncoding`).

methods.returns: The pending or committed entry visible in the batch, or `null` if missing.
methods.description: Get a key, value out of a batch.
examples: const entry = await batch.get('key')

methods.name: put

params.name: key
params.description: The key to insert (encoded per the batch's `keyEncoding`).

params.name: value
params.description: The value to store (encoded per the batch's `valueEncoding`); optional.

methods.returns: Resolves once the write is queued in the batch.
methods.description: Insert a key into a batch.
examples: await batch.put('key', 'value')

methods.name: del

params.name: key
params.description: The key to delete (encoded per the batch's `keyEncoding`).

methods.returns: Resolves once the deletion is queued in the batch.
methods.description: Delete a key into the batch.
examples: await batch.del('key')

methods.name: close
methods.returns: Resolves once the batch is discarded and its lock released.
methods.description: Destroy a batch, and releases any locks it has acquired on the db.
examples: await batch.close()

methods.name: flush
methods.returns: Resolves once the queued operations are committed and the lock released.
methods.description: Commit the batch to the database, and releases any locks it has acquired.
examples: await batch.flush()

typedefs.name: Entry
typedefs.description:
A single entry as returned by reads such as `db.get()`, `db.peek()`, and the
read stream. `key` and `value` are decoded with the bee's `keyEncoding` /
`valueEncoding` (raw `Buffer`s when no encoding is set).

properties.name: seq
properties.description: Hypercore index (block number) at which this entry was inserted.

properties.name: key
properties.description: The entry's key, decoded per `keyEncoding`.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The entry's value, decoded per `valueEncoding` (`null` for a deletion).

properties.name: keyEncoding
properties.description: Key encoding: `"binary"` (default), `"utf-8"`, `"ascii"`, `"json"`, or an abstract-encoding instance.

properties.name: valueEncoding
properties.description: Value encoding; same options as `keyEncoding`.

typedefs.name: PutOptions
typedefs.description: Options for `db.put()`, `db.del()` and their batch equivalents.

properties.name: cas
properties.description: Compare-and-swap comparator; the write only proceeds when it returns `true`.

typedefs.name: Range
typedefs.description:
Range bounds for read, diff, and watch streams. Keys are compared by their
encoded byte value.

properties.name: gt
properties.description: Only return keys greater than this.

properties.name: gte
properties.description: Only return keys greater than or equal to this.

properties.name: lt
properties.description: Only return keys less than this.

properties.name: lte
properties.description: Only return keys less than or equal to this.

properties.name: reverse
properties.description: Yield entries in reverse (descending) order.

properties.name: limit
properties.description: Maximum number of entries to return (`-1` for no limit).

properties.name: live
properties.description: Keep the stream open and wait for new data instead of ending.

properties.name: reverse
properties.description: Iterate from newest to oldest.

properties.name: gte
properties.description: Start at this seq (inclusive); negative values are added to the current version.

properties.name: gt
properties.description: Start after this seq.

properties.name: lte
properties.description: Stop at this seq (inclusive).

properties.name: lt
properties.description: Stop before this seq.

properties.name: limit
properties.description: Maximum number of entries to return (`-1` for no limit).

properties.name: sep
properties.description: Namespace separator placed between the prefix and key (defaults to the parent's separator).

properties.name: keyEncoding
properties.description: Key encoding for the sub (defaults to the parent's).

properties.name: valueEncoding
properties.description: Value encoding for the sub (defaults to the parent's).

typedefs.name: GetOptions
typedefs.description:
Options for point reads such as `db.get()` and `db.getBySeq()`. The encoding
overrides apply to this call only; remaining options are forwarded to the
underlying `core.get()`.

properties.name: keyEncoding
properties.description: Override the key encoding for this read.

properties.name: valueEncoding
properties.description: Override the value encoding for this read.

properties.name: wait
properties.description: Wait for the block to download from a peer if it isn't local.

properties.name: timeout
properties.description: Max milliseconds to wait for a block (`0` = no timeout).

properties.name: keyEncoding
properties.description: Override the key encoding for this batch.

properties.name: valueEncoding
properties.description: Override the value encoding for this batch.

properties.name: update
properties.description: Update the underlying core before the first operation resolves.

properties.name: keyEncoding
properties.description: Key encoding for the yielded snapshots (defaults to the bee's).

properties.name: valueEncoding
properties.description: Value encoding for the yielded snapshots (defaults to the bee's).

properties.name: keyEncoding
properties.description: Key encoding for the watched entry (defaults to the bee's).

properties.name: valueEncoding
properties.description: Value encoding for the watched entry (defaults to the bee's).

properties.name: keyEncoding
properties.description: Key encoding for the snapshot (defaults to the bee's).

properties.name: valueEncoding
properties.description: Value encoding for the snapshot (defaults to the bee's).
